The '''Trinovates''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="Lost Jedi" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] with three [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They were native to [[Trinovat]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], located on the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]]. Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was verdant, with numerous [[Farm/Legends|farms]] and [[Mining/Legends|mines]].<ref name="Atlas" /> In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Bounty Hunter]]'' dates itself to two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of {{Film|IV}}, equating to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Trinovate [[Pilliask]] was present on the planet [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]], playing the card game [[Seven card comet]] against the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Havet Storm]]. The Trinovate was almost out of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was preparing to call for the next round to be a "Tail game"&mdash;wherein credits from the "Comet tail" or pot were added to the credits available to win that round&mdash;when another player beat him to the call.<ref name="Lost Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trinovates first appeared in ''[[The Bounty Hunter]]'', a [[1994]] book written by [[Paul Cockburn]].<ref name="Lost Jedi" />
